provider_balance_usd.WHY_THE_DELTA_IS_NOT_MY_COST: The balance is the vendor's truth for the ACCOUNT, not for this job. Other jobs in this same session (the era-replay decide step, §2b) were calling DeepSeek on the same key over the same window, so $3.17 is an UPPER BOUND on this campaign and $2.12 is the per-call sum of the rows this campaign actually wrote. Quoting the balance delta as this job's cost would charge it for someone else's calls.
